doc: HUD part: the land action sheet: one sheet pinned right, next to the «Действия» button. A tap on a row acts at once; the root stage has only ✕, nested stages have ←; a tap on the scrim closes. `rows` = [{id, title, icon, disabled, pressed, chevron, cooldown, heading, here}] (`here`: the tile of the place the hero stands in, marked without text); `layout` rows (52 dp rows), dense (44 dp rows under headings; `headings` = how many) or tiles (two columns of place tiles). The sheet is as tall as its rows (constants) and never taller than the safe area; then the rows scroll.
